items.title: Water rescues, evacuations underway as ‘catastrophic flood event’ hits North Georgia and southern Tennessee
items.brief: Homes and businesses are flooded, and water rescues and evacuations are in progress, as historic flooding impacts North Georgia and southern Tennessee.

items.title: Nasdaq plunges into correction territory as midterm results raise fresh questions about AI boom
items.brief: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite plunged by as much as 5.5% Thursday as investors weighed whether Democrats’ gains in the midterm elections could lead to a slowdown in the massive data center buildout.

items.title: The Met Gala plays it safe with new exhibition theme
items.brief: Two months after causing public outcry for planning a 2027 Met Gala exhibit centered on John Galliano , the Metropolitan Museum of Art has announced a new theme: Dressing down.

items.title: Actor and comedian Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
items.brief: British actor, comedian and media personality Russell Brand faces a lengthy prison sentence after he was found guilty in a London court on Thursday of raping a young fan and sexually assaulting three women.
